local_inventory.limit: Names are diagnostic correspondence only. Missing debug declarations may reflect optimization, renaming or source omissions. Shadowed names are not paired. Type sizes do not prove stack allocation: registers, lifetime reuse, spills, alignment and outgoing arguments require separate evidence.

frame_layout.proof: Decoded constant SUB ESP in the straight-line entry prefix; no branches/calls crossed.
frame_layout.limit: Local widths are unique-name DWARF evidence, not complete frame accounting. Spill slots, outgoing call arguments, alignment and lifetime reuse also affect allocation. This never proves body or layout-only equality.

signedness.limit: DWARF variable types and function instruction counts; variable-to-instruction attribution requires location evidence. Char encoding is available through type DIE.

branch_context.limit: Each side is decoded independently. Equal offsets do not identify corresponding blocks; outside-function targets and indirect transfers are not resolved here. No source cause, CFG equivalence or layout proof is inferred.

instruction_alignment.normalization: Candidate absolute fields use independent resolved values; external transfers use independent targets; intra-function transfers use decoded instruction indices. Unresolved fields never align with original bytes.
instruction_alignment.limit: Sequence alignment is heuristic and may be ambiguous in repeated code. Equal groups are not body/semantic/layout proof. Never changes status, routing, edit permission or promotion.

known_rules.symptom: First differing instruction is a constant SUB ESP prologue allocation.
known_rules.known_source_cause: Not established by the allocation alone. Different local widths, spills, outgoing arguments, lifetimes or source expansion can change the frame.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Check the attached DWARF local-width evidence and calls before experimenting with register temporaries. Preserve x87 and historical flags; never change a frame size or padding to mask a source mismatch.

compiler_scope.acceptance: Decoded allocation is an observation, not an exact match or source-cause proof.

applicability.limit: Symptom filtering narrows hypotheses; it does not prove the source cause or authorize a repair. Historical example membership alone is not current applicability.

known_rules.symptom: A file-static to function-static declaration repair changes BSS symbol order and text operands even though expressions are unchanged.
known_rules.known_source_cause: On the locked main CU, moving face into main_menu_callback swaps face and number offsets. On fld_adspot with its locked flags, restoring localFilename scope preserves all emitted contributions.
known_rules.known_fix_pattern: Use the generated STATIC_SCOPE task and preservation gate. If it changes contributions, retain the symbol-offset differences, restore the source and route to a supervisor. Do not force placement or edit instruction expressions to compensate.

compiler_scope.flags: Per-CU locked configuration; observations do not establish a universal ordering rule.
